rounded_table_note: The CSV records four-decimal values exported in the anonymous static tables. Recomputing from these rounded rows gives 0.3221; the paper reports 0.3220 from the frozen unrounded analysis.
resampling_note: The submitted paper reports a descriptive bootstrap range of 0.2619--0.3836 and treats leave-one-out recomputation as a stability diagnostic. interpretation: The statistic is the mean clean-detection minus retained-robustness gap on the completed comparison surface. It is not a population prevalence estimate over all watermarking methods or providers.
